# DropFlow

> DropFlow is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) file converter that works 100% on the user's own device: drag a file,
> tap a key, and a radial wheel offers conversions, PDF tools, media tools and local AI (speech to text, OCR, background
> removal, English <-> Arabic translation). Nothing is uploaded. Desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux, an Android app,
> and a web app that runs in the browser. Arabic-first, also in English. An initiative of the ScoutHub platform.

## Pages

- [DropFlow (Arabic)](https://dropflow.scouthub.dev/ar): the home page in Arabic: downloads, features, supported formats, FAQ
- [DropFlow (English)](https://dropflow.scouthub.dev/en): the same home page in English
- [Web app](https://dropflow.scouthub.dev/en/app): convert PDF, images, text and media in the browser; files never leave the device
- [Privacy policy](https://dropflow.scouthub.dev/en/privacy): no uploads, no accounts, no cookies, no tracking
- [Terms of use](https://dropflow.scouthub.dev/en/terms): GPL-3.0-or-later, no warranty

## Downloads and source

- [Latest release](https://github.com/hamwimoustafa88-maker/dropflow/releases/latest): Windows (x64, ARM64), macOS, Linux, Android
- [Source code](https://github.com/hamwimoustafa88-maker/dropflow): C# / .NET desktop app, Next.js web app, Kotlin Android app
- [Security policy](https://github.com/hamwimoustafa88-maker/dropflow/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability
